## Equations
### cdhm_hamiltonian — Continuously driven Harper model H(k,t;beta) (Eq. 14)

$$
H = sum_l (J/2)(a_l^dag a_{l+1}+h.c.) + K cos(2 pi t/tau) sum_l cos(2 pi alpha l + beta) a_l^dag a_l, alpha=1/3, tau=2. Bloch 3x3: h_hop(k) with intra-cell hops J/2 and inter-cell hop (J/2)exp(i 3k); onsite diag K cos(2 pi t/tau) diag(cos beta, cos(2pi/3+beta), cos(4pi/3+beta)). k in [-pi/3,pi/3].
$$

status: `verified`

### floquet_eigenphases — Floquet operator eigen-equation and eigenphases omega_{n,k}(beta) (Eqs. 1, A1)

$$
U(beta)|psi_{n,k}(beta)> = exp(-i omega_{n,k}(beta))|psi_{n,k}(beta)>. Three gapped Floquet bands for alpha=1/3. Parallel-transport phase convention <psi|d psi/d beta>=0.
$$

status: `verified`

### initial_populations — Initial band populations rho_{n,k}(0)=|C_{n,k}(0)|^2 (Fig. 1b)

$$
C_{n,k}(0) = <psi_{n,k}(beta=0)|e_0>, with e_0=(1,0,0) the k-component of the site-0 initial state. rho_{n,k}(0)=|C_{n,k}(0)|^2, sum_n rho_{n,k}(0)=1.
$$

status: `verified`

### transition_amplitude_W — First-order amplitude C_{n,k}(1) and kernel W_{nm,k}(s) (Eqs. 4-6, A4-A11)

$$
dC_{n,k}/ds = -sum_{m!=n} exp(i(Omega_n-Omega_m)) C_{m,k} <psi_n|d psi_m/ds>. Integrating by parts: C_{n,k}(1)=C_{n,k}(0)+(1/T) sum_{m!=n} C_{m,k}(0)[W_{nm,k}(s)]_0^1, W_{nm,k}(s)=<psi_n|d psi_m/ds>/(1-exp(i(omega_n-omega_m))) exp(i(Omega_n(s)-Omega_m(s))). At s=0: W(0)=2pi<psi_n|d_beta psi_m>/(1-exp(i(omega_n-omega_m))), with <psi_n|d_beta psi_m>=<psi_n|d_beta U|psi_m>/(lam_m-lam_n).
$$

status: `verified`

Code: `src/theory.py::W0_kernel`


### population_change_delta_rho — Population change Delta rho_{n,k} after one cycle (Eq. 8, Fig. 2)

$$
Delta rho_{n,k} = (2/T) Re[ sum_{m!=n} C*_n(0) C_m(0) (W_{nm,k}|_0^1) ], with W_{nm}|_0^1=W_{nm}(0)[exp(i Phi_{nm})-1], Phi_{nm}=(gamma_n-gamma_m)-(Omega_n(1)-Omega_m(1)), Omega_n(1)=sum_j omega_n(beta_j) exact discrete accumulated phase. Scales as 1/T for a general (multi-band) initial state (IBC), vs 1/T^2 for a single-band initial state.
$$

status: `verified`

Code: `src/theory.py::delta_rho_theory`, `src/theory.py::accumulated_Omega`, `src/theory.py::berry_phase`


### berry_curvature — Berry curvature B_n(beta,k) and dgamma/dk (Eq. 11)

$$
B_n(beta,k)=i[<d_k psi_n|d_beta psi_n> - <d_beta psi_n|d_k psi_n>]; dgamma_{n,k}/dk = int_0^{2pi} dbeta B_n(beta,k). int_int B_n dk dbeta = 2 pi C_n (Chern number). Computed gauge-invariantly by the Fukui-Hatsugai-Suzuki plaquette method on the (k,beta) torus.
$$

status: `verified`

### avg_quasienergy — Average quasienergy E_{n,k} along the pumping cycle (Eq. 12)

$$
E_{n,k} = (1/T) Omega_{n,k}(1) = int_0^1 omega_{n,k}[beta(s)] ds = (1/2pi) int_0^{2pi} omega_{n,k}(beta) dbeta. dE_{n,k}/dk enters the IBC correction of Eq. (13).
$$

status: `verified`

### displacement_delta_x — One-cycle displacement Delta<x> = Berry integral + IBC correction (Eqs. 9-13, A26)

$$
Delta<x> = sum_n int dk int dbeta B_n(beta,k) rho_{n,k}(0)  -  2 sum_{m!=n} int dk Re[C*_n(0) C_m(0) (dE_{n,k}/dk) W_{nm,k}(0)]. Both terms independent of T; the second (IBC) survives the adiabatic limit. Units: atomic spacing; a filled band gives Delta x=a C_n (a=N=3), fixing the a/(2 pi) prefactor on both terms.
$$
